problem_type: Focus indication ignores text-editing versus command interaction
symptom: Clicking Agent composer shows a thick outer focus outline.
direct_cause: Global addBase selector applies the same 2px token outline to textarea:focus-visible as to buttons; Chromium matches text editing focus-visible after pointer input.
class_root: Design-system base does not distinguish text editing focus from keyboard command focus, leaving future callers to inherit the wrong visual contract.
affected_population: All mouse and keyboard users of text fields and contenteditable surfaces
Custom focusable controls omitted by the previous element whitelist

external_sources.purpose: Text field and Tab interaction guidance; does not mandate no outer ring.
Counterexample: strong accessible outer focus indication is intentional.

invariants: Text editing focus never draws an outer outline; existing field/container borders indicate focus without layout shift.
Non-text keyboard focus retains the shared token outline, including tabindex elements.
generality_proof: Semantic CSS selectors at addBase cover existing and future native text controls and contenteditable; direct-parent and nearest-bordered-container :has propagate focus to composite field borders without composer-specific CSS.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Own text versus non-text focus indication across renderer and portals.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Bare textarea nested directly in bordered form inherits global textarea:focus-visible despite outline-none utility.
Borderless search input inside bordered div; existing focus-within shadow duplicates global outline.

same_class_entry_points.entry_point: Shot row numeric input and keyframe textarea
same_class_entry_points.evidence: Independent storyboard fields inherit global input/textarea rules.

recurrence.reason: Any new text input reaches the same global focus-visible rule on each click.
same_class_scan: Read AgentPanelV4Composer, DesignSearchInput, DesignTextInput and StoryboardShotRow; inspect global scrollbar and Mantine appearance owners.

prevention.invariant: Text focus uses border color; non-text focus-visible uses one token outline.
prevention.failure_mode: Text selectors exclude the generic ring; generic focus reset prevents UA outline leakage.
prevention.strategy: Replace the old whitelist at its owner and remove duplicate search focus decoration.

legacy_paths.rationale: Replace old text-inclusive global outline and remove parallel SearchInput focus shadow.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Chromium focus-visible heuristics are intentional platform behavior, not a runtime defect. Keep installed Electron and Tailwind; own the presentation at the application boundary.
dependency_lifecycle.target: Current supported Electron Chromium with identical semantic selectors
exit_criteria: On Electron upgrade run shared focus matrix and Electron pointer/Tab journey; revisit only if selector support or focus heuristics change.

migration: No stored data changes. Rebuilding CSS replaces the global rule for every existing renderer.
residual_risks: #662 scanner integration deferred by explicit user instruction; standalone fixtures and regression remain executable.
